description: Submit and apply the mandatory IARC content rating questionnaire, using Play Console's own web session. Only content_rating_category="all_other_app_types" (every question answered No, producing the lowest possible rating) is currently supported — the correct choice for a brand-new app with no mature content.

content_rating_category.description: Must be "all_other_app_types" — the only supported value right now. Games and Social/Communication apps need a different questionnaire path not yet supported.

content_rating_contact_email.description: Contact email for content rating authorities / IARC correspondence.

developer_id.description: Numeric Play Console developer id (from the Play Console URL).

google_account_email.description: The signed-in Google account email that owns this Play Console developer account. Call list_accounts first and confirm with the user — do not guess.

notification_message.description: Short user-facing sentence for this action if the follow-up reply fails. Plain text only; do not mention template syntax or variable names.

play_app_id.description: Numeric Play app id from the Play Console URL (.../app/<this>/...). NOT the package name.

name: update_content_rating
